blocks.prompt: 7 (i) If \(a, b, c, d\) are in G.P., prove that: \(a - b,\ b - c,\ c - d\) are in G.P.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh proof wala sawal hai: dikhana hai ke teen naye expressions bhi G.P. mein hain.
Diya kya hai? \(a, b, c, d\) G.P. mein hain.
Saabit kya karna hai? \(a - b,\ b - c,\ c - d\) G.P. mein hain.
Rule kaunsa? Teen numbers tab G.P. mein hote hain jab doosre aur pehle ka ratio teesre aur doosre ke ratio ke barabar ho.
Plan: \(b, c, d\) ko \(a\) aur \(r\) mein likhenge, common factor bahar nikalenge, aur ratios compare karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a, b, c, d\) G.P. mein hain.
Saabit karna hai: \(a - b,\ b - c,\ c - d\) G.P. mein hain.
Tareeqa: Common ratio \(r\) maan lein; to
\[b = ar,\ c = ar^2,\ d = ar^3\]
Yeh is liye ke G.P. mein har term pichle ko \(r\) se multiply kar ke banta hai. Is tarah char alag letters ki jagah sirf do (\(a\) aur \(r\)) reh jate hain aur hisaab aasaan ho jata hai. Hum farz karte hain ke \(a \neq 0\) aur \(r \neq 1\), taake koi term zero na ho (zero se divide nahi ho sakta).

Har expression ko \(a\) aur \(r\) mein likhein
\[a - b = a - ar\]
\[= a(1 - r)\]
\[b - c = ar - ar^2\]
\[= ar(1 - r)\]
\[c - d = ar^2 - ar^3\]
\[= ar^2(1 - r)\]
Kyun: Har expression mein \((1 - r)\) maujood hai, is liye usay common factor ke taur par bahar nikala. Jaise \(ar - ar^2\) mein \(ar\) common hai, to \(ar(1 - r)\) bacha. Is shakal mein ratios lena bohat aasaan ho jata hai.

Saath wale terms ke ratios nikalein
\[\dfrac{ar(1 - r)}{a(1 - r)} = r\]
\[\dfrac{ar^2(1 - r)}{ar(1 - r)} = r\]
Kyun: Divide karte waqt common factor \((1 - r)\) aur \(a\) upar neeche cancel ho jate hain, sirf \(r\) ki powers bachti hain. Dono ratios barabar \(r\) aaye.
Dhyan dein: Cancel tabhi kar sakte hain jab woh cheez zero na ho; isi liye shuru mein sharait likhi thi.

Natija
\[\text{common ratio} = r\]
Kyun: Doosre aur pehle ka ratio aur teesre aur doosre ka ratio dono \(r\) hain. G.P. ki definition poori ho gayi, is liye teenon expressions G.P. mein hain.

Tasdeeq: numbers se
\[a, b, c, d = 1, 2, 4, 8\]
\[-1, -2, -4 \;(\text{ratio } 2)\]
Kyun: \(1, 2, 4, 8\) ek G.P. hai jis ka \(r = 2\). Is se bane teen numbers ka ratio waqai \(r\) (yani \(r = 2\) rakhne par) aaya. Proof ke baad aisa chhota sa test hamesha tasalli deta hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(a - b,\ b - c,\ c - d\) G.P. mein hain, common ratio \(r\).

blocks.prompt: 7 (ii) If \(a, b, c, d\) are in G.P., prove that: \(a^{2} - b^{2},\ b^{2} - c^{2},\ c^{2} - d^{2}\) are in G.P.

Diya kya hai? \(a, b, c, d\) G.P. mein hain.

\[a^2 - b^2 = a^2 - a^2r^2\]
\[= a^2(1 - r^2)\]
\[b^2 - c^2 = a^2r^2 - a^2r^4\]
\[= a^2r^2(1 - r^2)\]
\[c^2 - d^2 = a^2r^4 - a^2r^6\]
\[= a^2r^4(1 - r^2)\]

Saath wale terms ke ratios nikalein
\[\dfrac{a^2r^2(1 - r^2)}{a^2(1 - r^2)} = r^2\]
\[\dfrac{a^2r^4(1 - r^2)}{a^2r^2(1 - r^2)} = r^2\]
Kyun: Divide karte waqt common factor \((1 - r^2)\) aur \(a^2\) upar neeche cancel ho jate hain, sirf \(r\) ki powers bachti hain. Dono ratios barabar \(r^2\) aaye.
Dhyan dein: Cancel tabhi kar sakte hain jab woh cheez zero na ho; isi liye shuru mein sharait likhi thi.

Natija
\[\text{common ratio} = r^2\]
Kyun: Doosre aur pehle ka ratio aur teesre aur doosre ka ratio dono \(r^2\) hain. G.P. ki definition poori ho gayi, is liye teenon expressions G.P. mein hain.

Tasdeeq: numbers se
\[a, b, c, d = 1, 2, 4, 8\]
\[-3, -12, -48 \;(\text{ratio } 4)\]
Kyun: \(1, 2, 4, 8\) ek G.P. hai jis ka \(r = 2\). Is se bane teen numbers ka ratio waqai \(r^2\) (yani \(r = 2\) rakhne par) aaya. Proof ke baad aisa chhota sa test hamesha tasalli deta hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(a^2 - b^2,\ b^2 - c^2,\ c^2 - d^2\) G.P. mein hain, common ratio \(r^2\).
